notes.absenceDefinition: Absent = the shift ended without a check-in (Attendance's rule).
notes.acceptanceFormula: Offer acceptance rate = accepted ÷ (accepted + rejected + expired) offers. Drafts, offers awaiting an answer and withdrawn offers are not counted.
notes.aggregateOnly: Totals only: no individual personal details are shown or exported.
notes.allRunStatuses: Lists runs in every status; totals of unfinished runs can still change.
notes.appliedInRange: Candidates who applied in the period.
notes.approvedCoveringToday: Approved leave covering {{day}}. Pending requests are not included.
notes.approvedLeaveOnly: Only approved leave counts as on leave; pending requests do not.
notes.archivedExcluded: Archived applications are not included (the pipeline as Recruitment shows it).
notes.attendanceRateFormula: Attendance rate = attended days ÷ (attended + absent days). Attended = present, late, half day or incomplete.
notes.attendanceWindow: Attendance keeps records from {{from}}; earlier dates are not available.
notes.balanceFormula: Remaining = allocated − used − pending (Leave Management's balances). Pending days are reserved, not used.
notes.balanceYear: Balances of {{year}} (the year of the period's end date).
notes.builderDataset: Built from an existing report's records with the fields you chose.
notes.candidateToEmployeeFormula: Candidate-to-employee rate = candidates converted to employee records ÷ applicants in the period.
notes.completedReviewsOnly: Ratings come from completed manager reviews only.
notes.completenessFormula: Completeness = verified required documents ÷ required documents (Documents Management's checklist).
notes.completionFormula: Completion rate = completed reviews ÷ reviews in the cycle.
notes.complianceFormula: Compliance rate = verified (not expired) required documents ÷ all required documents.
notes.conversionStepFormula: Step conversion = candidates reaching a step ÷ candidates reaching the previous step.
notes.correlationNotCausation: Figures are shown side by side for comparison. A difference between departments does not show what causes it.
notes.currentAssignment: Department, location and employment type are the employees' current values.
notes.currentDocuments: Current documents only: archived and superseded documents are not included.
notes.currentState: Shows the current state, whatever the period.
notes.cyclesOverlapping: Review cycles whose dates overlap the period.
notes.dailyLastDay: Records of {{day}} (the period's last day, never after today).
notes.departureDate: Leavers are counted on the date they became inactive (from the employment history).
notes.employeeDepartment: Grouped by the employee's current department.
notes.employeeDocumentsOnly: Employee documents only (candidate documents are not included).
notes.expiredDefinition: Expired = past the expiry date (Documents Management's status).
notes.feedbackOwnOnly: Interview recommendations include only the feedback you may read.
notes.finalRunsOnly: Approved and paid payroll runs only (Payroll's reports). Drafts, calculated, rejected and cancelled runs are not included.
notes.funnelAllTime: The funnel covers all candidates in your scope; the period and department filters do not apply to it.
notes.funnelFromHistory: Each candidate counts once for every step reached (from the pipeline history).
notes.goalsActiveInRange: Goals whose start and due dates overlap the period.
notes.gracePeriod: "Due within grace period" documents are required but still within the allowed time.
notes.headcountMonthEnd: Headcount = employees employed at the end of the month.
notes.hireDateInRange: Employees whose hire date is in the period.
notes.insightGroupSize: Departments with fewer than {{n}} active employees are not compared.
notes.insufficientData: Fewer than {{n}} departments have comparable data for these filters.
notes.lateDefinition: Late = checked in after the shift start plus grace time; minutes late count from the start.
notes.leaveOverlap: Requests overlapping the period; days are the request's working days.
notes.missingHireDates: {{n}} hires without an application or acceptance date are not included.
notes.monthByStart: Requests are counted in the month they start.
notes.noAllocationBlank: Leave types without an annual allocation have no allocated or remaining figure.
notes.noAttendanceData: There is no attendance data for this period.
notes.noComments: Written comments and self-assessment texts are never included.
notes.noCompletedReviews: No completed reviews for these filters.
notes.noFinalPayroll: No approved or paid payroll for this period.
notes.noReasons: Reasons and attached documents of requests are not included.
notes.noRulesApply: Employees without any required-document rule have no completeness figure.
notes.notStartedNotAbsent: "Not started" days (shift not over, no check-in yet) are never counted as absent.
notes.openDaysNoHours: Days without a check-out have no worked hours yet.
notes.openPositionsFormula: Open positions = vacancies − hires of each open requisition.
notes.ownerDepartment: Grouped by the owner's current department.
notes.pendingNotApproved: Pending days are shown separately and never counted as approved leave.
notes.personalHidden: Personal details of {{n}} employees were not available.
notes.probationRecentHires: Probation ends within a year of hiring, so active employees hired in the last 13 months are checked.
notes.rangeClamped: Attendance reports cover at most {{days}} days: shown from {{from}}.
notes.ratingVisibleOnly: Ratings appear only for completed reviews you may see.
notes.ratingsMinimum: Average ratings are shown only for departments with at least {{n}} completed reviews.
notes.recommendationsFromFeedback: Recommendations come from submitted interview feedback.
notes.requiredRules: Based on the required-document rules in Documents Management.
notes.restrictedGrouped: Highly confidential documents (identity, medical…) are counted only as "Restricted categories".
notes.restrictedHidden: {{n}} highly confidential documents are not listed.
notes.shareOfActive: Share = active employees in the group ÷ all active employees.
notes.shiftSnapshot: Shifts as they were on each day.
notes.singleCurrency: All amounts are in {{currency}}; other currencies are never mixed in.
notes.snapshotDepartment: Department as recorded on each attendance day.
notes.startedBeforeRange: Requests that started before the period are not in the monthly figures.
notes.timeToHireFormula: Time to hire = days from application to accepting the offer, for hires accepted in the period.
notes.turnoverFormula: Turnover rate = leavers ÷ average headcount, where average headcount = (opening + closing) ÷ 2.
notes.turnoverNoReasons: Leaving reasons (resignation, dismissal…) are not recorded, so voluntary and involuntary turnover cannot be separated.
notes.unfinishedRunTotals: Runs that are not calculated yet have no totals.
notes.unknownDepartures: {{n}} inactive employees have no recorded departure date and are not counted as leavers.
notes.unlimitedTypesExcluded: Leave types without an allocation (e.g. unpaid leave) are not included.
notes.verifiedNotExpired: Verified documents that have not expired.
notes.workingDaysDefinition: Working days exclude days that have not started yet.
